note: Inputs are chosen dyadic (integer plus a multiple of 1/4) so the double subtraction is EXACT and the expected age is hand-verifiable, except message_age_needs_17_digits, whose whole purpose is a non-representable difference (0.1) that must render identically on both sides. Only that one string was computed; the rest are read off by hand. Do NOT regenerate any of them to make a failing test pass -- a disagreement means the arithmetic or the rendering diverged, which is the bug this file exists to catch.

vectors.name: produced_age_mono_and_boot_match
vectors.why: Branch 1: mono present and boot == local -> now_mono - mono. The real produced age. now=4821.75, mono=4821.25 -> exactly 0.5.

vectors.name: produced_age_needs_17_digits
vectors.why: Branch 1 with a NON-representable difference: now=0.1, mono=0.0 -> the double nearest 0.1, which %.17g renders as 0.10000000000000001. This is the only computed string; it pins that both languages print the same 17 digits, not a nicer rounding.

vectors.name: boot_mismatch_falls_back_to_rx
vectors.why: Branch 2: mono present but boot != local -> now_mono - rx_mono, NOT now_mono - mono. now=4821.75, rx=4821.5 -> 0.25; using mono would have given 0.5, so the two branches are distinguishable.

vectors.name: cloud_no_mono_falls_back_to_rx
vectors.why: Branch 3: mono absent (a cloud publisher omits it, CLK-C4) -> now_mono - rx_mono. now=101.0, rx=100.5 -> 0.5. The envelope carries no mono and no boot.

vectors.name: negative_age_on_produced_branch_clamps_to_zero
vectors.why: Branch 4 via branch 1: boot matches but now_mono < mono (a backward wall step misjudged, or an out-of-order arrival). raw = 4821.25 - 4821.75 = -0.5, clamped to 0, was_negative true. The raw carries the -0.5 the event would report.

vectors.name: negative_age_on_fallback_branch_clamps_to_zero
vectors.why: Branch 4 via branch 3: cloud packet (no mono), now_mono < rx_mono. raw = 200.0 - 200.5 = -0.5, clamped to 0, was_negative true. Proves the clamp applies on the fallback branch too, not only the produced one.

vectors.name: zero_age_from_equality_is_not_negative
vectors.why: now_mono == mono exactly -> age 0 and was_negative FALSE. This distinguishes 'zero because equal' (branch 1, not negative) from 'zero because clamped' (branch 4). A clamp that fired on age <= 0 instead of age < 0 would flip was_negative here.
